name: EIC Accelerator
description: The European Innovation Council (EIC) Accelerator provides grants and equity investments to startups and SMEs developing breakthrough technologies, including quantum computing. It has funded companies such as SemiQon and eleQtron combining a grant component of up to €2.5 million with an equity investment of €1–10 million, and its 2026 work programme allocates over €1.4 billion for strategic technologies.

news.title: Meet Europe's biggest deeptech investor (hint: it's not a VC)
news.excerpt: The EIC Fund has become the continent's biggest deeptech investor, completing over 300 investment rounds and outspending private VCs in quantum, AI, health, biotech and space sectors

news.title: EIC selects 35 deep-tech companies for Accelerator support
news.excerpt: The European Innovation Council selected 35 start-ups and SMEs from 17 EU and associated countries for EIC Accelerator support, with EUR 84 million in proposed grant funding; 32 of them will be assessed for EIC Fund equity investments of up to EUR 10 million each. 453 proposals submitted full applications and 88 reached the interview stage. None of the named example companies is a quantum company.

news.title: European Innovation Council launches EUR 1.8 billion in funding for 2027
news.excerpt: The European Commission adopted the 2027 EIC Work Programme, making EUR 1.8 billion available across EIC funding schemes, including the Accelerator, for 2027.
